title: Chapter 52 — Stage 0 consistency rulings
lede: 10 rulings after transcript adjudication. Gary ran both Valphine and Brewbarry. The audit found 11 issues; three additional findings came from manual review.
footer: No recap edits applied. Stages 1, 2 and 3 NOT RUN: artifacts absent. Bimbo remains the approved table nickname; dinner tonight is supported by the transcript.

items.t: Moderate: Narrow Margaster’s control to harbor distribution
items.y: Replace broad shipping-monopoly claims with control of distribution out of Neverwinter’s harbor. Apply to gm-assist.md only, then inspect related artifacts for propagation.
items.n: Leave gm-assist.md unchanged on this point and record the finding as deferred.
items.ev: gm-assist.md:8; notes/neverwinter/the_commission.md. The transcript uses broad conversational language, while the standing doctrine leaves overland trade available.
